_doc: Keys (or prefixes) the locale pruner must never delete, regardless of static analysis. Use this when a key is provably referenced at runtime but the scanner can't see it (joined-string roots, cross-function plumbing, property access in templates, etc.). Add entries with a one-line comment in the trailing _notes block so reviewers can challenge each one.

_notes.commands.personal.deliberatetriggermode: ${mode}_option built in metrics/status/personalPages.ts from the stored personal_dtm value; description aliased in commandLoader.ts.
_notes.commands.personal.deliberatetoolmode: Same pattern as deliberatetriggermode, from personal_deliberate_tool_mode.
_notes.genai.google: ${messageKey} for streaming error messages; key flows through provider adapter chains the scanner can't trace.
_notes.commands.config.cooldown.type.choice_str: choice_${getCooldownTypeSuffix(type)} in ui/moderationPanel.ts. The option can no longer be selected, but whitelist rows already stored as cooldown type 4 still render through that path.
